usedFor: Zoho CRM holds the accounts and deals, and Google Sheets holds the rows your team reports from. A “New Deals” in Zoho CRM can run “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets to change columns on a row.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deals” in Zoho CRM, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A new deal updates a row your team already tracks, instead of adding a second one. “New Account” feeds the same action when you track by company.

watchOut: Both Zoho CRM triggers are polling, so rows change on a schedule. “Update Spreadsheet Row” edits an existing row, so point it at one that already exists.
